messages:
anya: Postmortem follow-up for INC-8220  auth-service heartbeat flaps caused repeated pages across many replicas. Idea: heartbeat-aware probabilistic dedupe to reduce fanout noise but keep signal for cross-shard failures.
paul: Explain probabilistic dedupe? like sample pages when fanout low, escalate when it looks correlated? :thinking:
diego: Rough sketch: compute a per-fingerprint heart_rate and host_entropy. If heart_rate spikes but host_entropy low (one host), prefer retry + slack. If host_entropy high, bypass dedupe. Also use probabilistic sampling on first 30s: only 1/N pages escalate when N hosts < 3 to avoid overpaging on tiny bursts.
anya: Right. We still need "at least one" page per owning team for accountability. So rules: 1) owner_affinity always yields a guaranteed page at level=owner_contact for first event 2) for cross-owner fanout, use sampling to limit immediate pager storm.
paul: Could we implement as three components: fingerprinting lib, heartbeat detector, sampling policy in alertproxy? who can own each?
diego: I can take fingerprinting + heartbeat detector. ETA Wed. Will push a small lib that normalizes messages and emits: fingerprint, heart_rate, host_set_count.
anya: I'll own sampling policy + runbook updates. ETA Fri. Policy will be configurable per-service: sample_rate param and entropy_threshold.
pagerbot: Note: current oncall rotation  anya -> primary, diego -> secondary. Use /incident link INC-8220 for testing.
paul: Metrics to add: alerts.sampled.count, alerts.heartbeat.rate, alerts.host_entropy. Also new panel: sampled_pages_ratio(service) over 24h.
diego: Implementation note: use reservoir sampling for first 30s of a burst, then switch to deterministic rules after 30s based on host_entropy. Pseudocode:
```
burst_window = 30s
if within_burst_window:
  if host_set_count <= 2:
    if sample_reservoir.favors(fingerprint):
      deliver = pager
    else:
      deliver = slack
  else:
    deliver = pager
else:
  evaluate sustained rules (for: 5m etc.)
```
anya: We need safety overrides: absolute thresholds (errors/min > X) always page regardless of sampling. Also when a deploy is tagged, widen sampling but add an expiring annotation so oncall knows this is deploy-noise tolerant.
paul: Ownership + ETA matrix: diego (fingerprint + heartbeat lib + metrics) ETA Wed EOD; anya (sampling policy + alertproxy hook + runbook) ETA Fri; paul (dashboards + canary automation) ETA Mon next week.
sre-bot: Created task ACT-8220-FU and assigned diego, anya, paul.
diego: I'll include unit tests and a small CLI that simulates different entropy patterns. Will post PR to #eng-releases when ready.
anya: Rollout plan: staging tests with synthetic heartbeats for 48h, then canary in eu-central 24h, observe sampled_pages_ratio and alerts.repaged_after_sampling. Revert conditions: if repaged_after_sampling > 1% or missed critical pager during canary.
paul: I'll add grafana alerts to watch those metrics and tie them into the staging runbook.
anya: Action items recap:
- diego: fingerprint + heartbeat detector + metrics (Wed EOD)
- anya: sampling policy, alertproxy hook, runbook (Fri)
- paul: dashboards + canary orchestration (Mon)
We'll check in next Tue 09:30 PT for staging results. Thanks :slightly_smiling_face:
sre-bot: Reminder: link created INC-8220-FOLLOWUP and scheduled Tue 09:30 PT checkin.
